notes.title: EA 1.10
notes.notes:
Rhythmic Keyboard changes for EA 1.10:
- Playing Custom Songs now allow players to earn points toward Talent purchases
- Bug fixes and Key location accuracy improved
- Added keystroke feedback (Perfect, Good, Miss)
- Perfect keystrokes grant additional points
- Added new Talent, Perfection, that provides a chance for Perfect keystrokes to reset ability cooldowns
- The Talent, Time Dilation, is now free and provided for use automatically (points were refunded if a player purchased in previous versions)
- Added new anti-aliasing type, Temporal Super Resolution (TSR)
- Updated to Unreal Engine 5
- Added some graphical improvements and cosmetic changes

notes.title: Automatic Save for Custom Song Stats
notes.notes: Added an automatic save for Custom Song stats (BPM, Start Beat, End Beat); the function queries the name of the file (excluding extension), so ensure each distinct song has a distinct file name

notes.title: Custom Song Selection
notes.notes:
A new feature is now available in Rhythmic Keyboard: Custom Song Selection! Players can now select music ([b]MP3[/b], [b]WAV[/b], and [b]OGG Vorbis[/b] supported) from their personal library to be used during gameplay. 

Enjoy typing while listening to your favorite music. The only information you need is: the song's BPM, your desired start beat, and desired end beat; the procedural algorithm does the rest. All gameplay features are available during custom song playback; however, no talent points will be earned upon completion of gameplay with a custom song.
